title: 🛋️ Furniture & There is / There are
description: Учим мебель и бытовую технику, конструкцию there is/there are и притяжательные местоимения. Уровень A0. 6 дней.

days.title: Day 1: Furniture and Appliances
days.description: Учим названия мебели и бытовой техники

grammar.title: Furniture and Appliances
grammar.rule:
Мебель (furniture) и бытовая техника (appliances) в доме:

🪑 table — стол
🛋️ sofa — диван
🪑 chair — стул
🛏️ bed — кровать
📚 bookshelf — книжный шкаф
🚪 wardrobe — гардероб, шкаф для одежды

Бытовая техника:
📺 TV — телевизор
💻 computer — компьютер
🧊 fridge — холодильник
🍳 cooker — плита
🧺 washing machine — стиральная машина

🎯 Вопрос: What's in your room? — Что в твоей комнате?
examples: Leo: 'My bed is always unmade. Mum is not happy.' 🛏️😅
Mia: 'There's a huge TV in the living room. My dad watches football every night.' 📺⚽
Sam: 'Our fridge is full of food, but there's never anything I want to eat!' 🧊😭
grammar.keywords: table, sofa, chair, bed, bookshelf, wardrobe, TV, computer, fridge, cooker, washing machine

vocabulary.example: I sleep on the sofa when I watch TV late.
vocabulary.context_example: Я сплю на диване, когда поздно смотрю телевизор.

vocabulary.example: My bed is my favourite place.
This chair is very comfortable.
We eat dinner at the table.
My bookshelf is full of books I haven't read.
vocabulary.context_example: Мой книжный шкаф полон книг, которые я не читал.

vocabulary.example: My wardrobe is full of clothes I never wear.
vocabulary.context_example: Мой шкаф полон одежды, которую я никогда не ношу.

vocabulary.example: I watch YouTube on my TV.
I do my homework on the computer.
There is pizza in the fridge!

exercises.question: Where do you sleep? 🛏️
Where do you keep food cold? 🧊
I watch cartoons on the ___ . (TV / computer)
I keep my clothes in the ___ . (wardrobe / bookshelf)
A washing machine is for washing clothes.

grammar.title: Compound nouns
grammar.rule:
Сложные слова (compound nouns) образуются из двух слов:

📚 bookshelf = book + shelf (книжный шкаф)
🚪 wardrobe — не составное, просто запомни!
🛋️ armchair = arm + chair (кресло)
🛏️ bedroom = bed + room (спальня)
🍽️ dining room = dining + room (столовая)
🧺 washing machine = washing + machine (стиральная машина)
📺 TV = television (не составное)

🎯 Лайфхак: Если видишь два слова вместе — это часто сложное слово!
examples: Leo: 'My bedroom has a wardrobe and a bookshelf.' 🛏️📚
Mia: 'We have a dining room, but we eat in the kitchen.' 🍽️
Sam: 'Our washing machine is very loud. Sounds like a rocket!' 🚀🧺
grammar.keywords: compound nouns, bookshelf, bedroom, armchair, dining room, washing machine

vocabulary.example: Grandpa sleeps in his armchair.
The washing machine is in the bathroom.
We eat dinner in the dining room.
There are magazines on the coffee table.
I read under my lamp at night.

exercises.question: What is a 'bookshelf'? 📚
Which word is a compound noun? 🧺
exercises.explanation: Washing machine = washing + machine — стиральная машина!

exercises.question: Bed + room = ___
Dining + room = ___
'Armchair' is a compound noun.

days.title: Day 3: Grammar — there is / there are
days.description: Учим конструкцию there is/there are (есть, находится)

grammar.title: There is / There are
grammar.rule:
Конструкция there is/there are используется, чтобы сказать, ЧТО ГДЕ-ТО НАХОДИТСЯ.

📌 there is + единственное число:
✅ There is a sofa in the living room.
❌ There is two sofas. (неправильно!)

📌 there are + множественное число:
✅ There are two chairs in the kitchen.
❌ There are a chair. (неправильно!)

📌 Вопрос: Is there a TV? / Are there any chairs?
📌 Отрицание: There isn't a bed. / There aren't any tables.

🎯 Мем: 'There is a phone in my hand. There are 100 unread messages on it.' 📱
examples: Leo: 'There is a computer in my room. There are also 50 games on it.' 💻🎮
Mia: 'There is a cat on the sofa. There are no dogs in my house.' 🐱
Sam: 'There aren't any snacks in the fridge. This is an emergency!' 🚨🧊
grammar.keywords: there is, there are, is there, are there, there isn't, there aren't

vocabulary.example: There is a picture on the wall.
There is a mirror in the bathroom.
There are many toys on the floor.
There is a plant on the windowsill.
There is a candle on the table.

exercises.question: Which sentence is correct? 🛋️
exercises.explanation: sofas — множественное число, нужно there are!

exercises.question: Which sentence is correct? 🪑
exercises.explanation: chair — единственное число, нужно there is!

exercises.question: ___ a cat on the sofa. (There is / There are)
___ two chairs in the kitchen. (There is / There are)
'There are a book on the table.' — This sentence is correct.
exercises.explanation: Book — один, нужно 'There is a book on the table.' 📖

days.title: Day 4: Grammar — Possessive adjectives
days.description: Учим притяжательные местоимения (мой, твой, его, её, наш, их)

grammar.title: Possessive Adjectives
grammar.rule:
Притяжательные местоимения показывают, кому что принадлежит.

👤 I → my — мой (my phone)
👤 you → your — твой, ваш (your bag)
👤 he → his — его (his computer)
👤 she → her — её (her room)
👤 it → its — его/её (для животных и предметов) (its tail)
👤 we → our — наш (our house)
👤 they → their — их (their car)

🎯 Лайфхак: В английском нет слова 'свой' — используем my/your/his/her/our/their!
🎯 Мем: 'This is my bed. This is your bed. That is his bed. We all have beds.' 🛏️
examples: Leo: 'This is MY smartphone. Don't touch it!' 📱😠
Mia: 'HER room is always clean. MY room is... creative mess.' 🎨
Sam: 'OUR fridge is empty. THEIR fridge is full. Life is unfair!' 🧊😭
grammar.keywords: my, your, his, her, its, our, their

vocabulary.example: This is my phone.
Is this your backpack?
That is his computer.
Her room is pink.
Our house is big.
Their garden is beautiful.

exercises.question: I have a phone. It is ___ phone. 📱
Mia has a room. It is ___ room. 🛏️
Leo has a computer. It is ___ computer. 💻
We have a house. It is ___ house. 🏠
She has a cat. It is her cat.

days.title: Day 5: Practice — Furniture + there is/there are + possessive adjectives

grammar.title: Revision: Furniture, There is/are, Possessive adjectives
grammar.rule:
Сегодня соединяем всё, что учили!

📌 Мебель и техника: sofa, bed, chair, table, bookshelf, wardrobe, TV, computer, fridge, washing machine
📌 Конструкция: There is / There are — что где находится
📌 Притяжательные: my, your, his, her, its, our, their

🎯 Структура: 'There is a sofa in my living room.'
🎯 Вопрос: 'Is there a TV in your bedroom?'
examples: Leo: 'There is a computer in my room. There are also 100 games on his computer.' 💻
Mia: 'There is a plant in her room. There are flowers in our garden.' 🌸
Sam: 'There aren't any snacks in their fridge. But there is pizza in our fridge!' 🍕
grammar.keywords: revision, furniture, there is/are, possessive adjectives

exercises.question: Choose the correct sentence: 🛋️
options: There is two sofas in the living room.
There are two sofas in the living room.
There is a two sofas in the living room.
There are a two sofas in the living room.
exercises.correct: There are two sofas in the living room.

exercises.question: Leo has a bed. It is ___ bed. 🛏️
___ a lamp on the table. (There is / There are)
We have a washing machine. It is ___ washing machine. 🧺
Mia and Sam have a dog. It is ___ dog. 🐕
There are a bookshelf in my room.
exercises.correct: There is a bookshelf in my room.

days.title: Day 6: Reading — Flat for Rent (What's wrong with this flat?)
days.description: Читаем объявление о сдаче квартиры с юмором

grammar.title: Reading: Flat for Rent
grammar.rule: Сегодня читаем объявление о сдаче квартиры, где всё пошло не так. Используем there is/there are и притяжательные местоимения!
grammar.keywords: reading, flat, rent, funny, there is, there are

exercises.question: How many bedrooms are there in the flat? 🛏️
exercises.explanation: The text says: 'There are two bedrooms.'
exercises.readingText:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🏠 FLAT FOR RENT — THE TRUTH
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📍 AD: 'Beautiful flat in the city centre. Perfect for a family!'

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

THE TRUTH (from the previous tenant):

🛋️ LIVING ROOM
There is a sofa in the living room. There is also a mysterious stain on it. We don't talk about the stain.
There is a TV, but there is no remote control. Good luck!

🍳 KITCHEN
There is a fridge. There is no food inside. Just old ketchup from 2019.
There is a cooker, but there is no oven. Microwaved pizza only! 🍕

🛏️ BEDROOMS
There are two bedrooms. There is a bed in each room. There are also strange noises at night. Probably just mice. 🐭
There is a wardrobe in the main bedroom. There is nothing inside except one lonely sock.

🚿 BATHROOM
There is a shower. There is no hot water. Cold showers build character, right? 💪
There is a mirror. There is a crack in it. Seven years bad luck!

🚗 OTHER
There is no parking. There is no lift. The flat is on the fifth floor. Prepare your legs! 🦵
There is a washing machine. There is no instruction manual. Guess the buttons!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

PREVIOUS TENANT'S COMMENT: 'There is a reason I'm moving out. There are many reasons, actually.' 😭
